messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deployment 2026.03.15T10:02Z promoted to prod (service: inference-gateway). Observed anomaly: spike in 5xx and timeouts starting at 10:05Z. p95 latency increased from 120ms -> 1.6s; p99 from 310ms -> 6.2s. Relevant metrics: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/d/abcd/inference-gateway?from=now-30m
Maria (oncall): I'm on it, pulling logs and traces. Paging SRE. Anyone oncall for platform?
Ben (platform): I'm here. Saw the alert, correlating with traffic to blue pool after the canary cutover.
Carla (sre): Adding context: new multiplexing change toggled in the router config in the deploy. Could be connection pooling issue. Seeing many upstream "connection_acquire_timeout" in router logs.
Maria (oncall): Repro snippet from edge logs: ```
[10:05:12] WARN transport: timeout acquiring connection to 10.12.4.23: connection_acquire_timeout
[10:05:13] ERROR proxy: upstream 504 gateway timeout for req id=abc123
```
Ben (platform): Yep. Multiplex flag set to true in rollout. The change reduces sockets but increases per-connection concurrency. If upstream NGINX pool size not adjusted, requests queue and hit timeouts.
Maria (oncall): Impact: elevated 5xx across 3 regions. Customer-facing APIs using hosted endpoints seeing increased request failures, affecting interactive chat & streaming. Monitoring Bot shows ~18% 5xx for a 5m window at peak.
Sam (pm): How widespread? Any paid customer pager hits?
Carla (sre): Quick check: error volume concentrated on prod gateway instances that received the promoted revision (blue). Canaries were small and fine. Promotion pinned to all blue nodes at 10:02Z.
Ben (platform): Mitigation options: 1) revert multiplex toggle (slow config rollback), 2) increase upstream connection pool (risky at scale), 3) rollback deploy entirely. Given blast radius, I recommend immediate rollback of the release to previous revision.
Maria (oncall): I concur — reduce customer impact fast. Who can execute rollback?
Carla (sre): I'll do it. Rolling back now. ```bash
# deployctl rollback 
deployctl rollback --service inference-gateway --to-revision 2026.03.14.21 --confirm
```
deploy-bot: Rollback job queued: jb-9981. Progress updates will follow.
Carla (sre): Rolling through regions, starting us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1. Watching health checks.
Ben (platform): I'm standing by to adjust pool sizes if needed after stable.
Maria (oncall): Noted. Communicating to support to throttle customer escalations. Creating incident ticket INC-20260315-27.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed on 10:12:34Z. Service revision now 2026.03.14.21. Checks: green.
Carla (sre): Post-rollback metrics look good: p95 back to ~130ms, p99 ~340ms, 5xx <0.5%. Monitoring Bot confirms steady state. https://telemetry.redwood.internal/d/abcd/inference-gateway?from=now-15m
Maria (oncall): Confirming end-user error rates dropped. Support: please update customer threads that injection rollback applied and we are monitoring. 
Sam (pm): Notifying key customers. Assigning postmortem to Ben + Carla to own RCA. Please capture timeline, configuration diff (multiplex toggle), and runbook gaps.
Carla (sre): Will kick off postmortem doc. Preliminary hypothesis: multiplex change reduced socket count but we failed to coordinate upstream pool tuning and staged rollout constraints, causing connection acquisition timeouts under normal load bursts.
Ben (platform): Action items: 1) add automated preflight that checks pooled connection headroom for multiplex mode, 2) add canary gating that keeps promotion paused until connection_acquire_timeout rate is zero for 5m, 3) update rollback playbook with faster cli steps.
Maria (oncall): Handoff to post-incident channel. Oncall remains Maria until 12:00Z for any late regressions.
Monitoring Bot: Incident INC-20260315-27 closed (mitigated). Please file postmortem within 72 hours. :white_check_mark:
